row.team_price_text: Starter: per user, per month, billed annually (price not in fetched page)
row.evidence: Capsule's security page says you can "use Single Sign-On (SSO) with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or QuickBooks"; users are invited manually and no SCIM or provisioning endpoint appears in the help centre, sitemap or developer API.
row.notes: New row. Plans: Free (max 2 users), Starter, Growth, Advanced, Ultimate, priced per user per month billed annually; the dollar amounts are script-loaded and were not readable (renderer blocked), so prices are null. SSO is Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace domain sign-in (available on all plans per the Microsoft 365 help article); there is no SAML or generic OIDC, so sso_plan 'Free' rests on tenant-bound Microsoft/Google SSO, flagged for review. With Microsoft 365 SSO on, only people in the Microsoft 365 directory can be added as users, but adding and removing is still manual. The Okta catalogue app is SWA only. API v2 can list/show users and teams and update user preferences only. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Dollar price is loaded by script and was not in the fetched page (headless renderer blocked on capsulecrm.com).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented: the security page offers 2FA and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace / QuickBooks sign-in only, user management is manual invites, and the developer API (v2) has read and preference-update endpoints for users. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: List all users on the account
Show the user tied to the access token
Update a user's preferences (needs user_preference scope)

webhooks_user_events.notes: REST hooks exist (e.g. party/created); no user events found.

rate_limits.text: 4,000 requests per hour per Capsule user (bearer token).

limitations.text: No documented endpoint creates, invites, removes or re-roles users; user writes are limited to preferences.

okta.notes: OIN app marks only SWA as supported (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Capsule's own Microsoft 365 SSO (admin consent from Capsule settings); no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (capsule-crm-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Capsule's own Google Workspace SSO; no Google catalogue entry checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: With Microsoft 365 SSO on, new users are picked from the Microsoft 365 directory, but each invite is still manual
